facts.claim: Sea reported Q3 2026 results (quarter ended Sept 30, 2026) on November 10, 2026; this is the most recent reported quarter as of Nov 13, 2026.
facts.note: Release seen via reprint excerpts only.

facts.claim: Sea group total revenue rose about 43% year on year to roughly US$8.6 billion.
facts.note: One outlet gives US$8.58B.

facts.claim: Group net income was about US$502.5 million (+34% YoY) and total adjusted EBITDA was US$931.3 million.
facts.note: Secondary coverage.

facts.claim: Adjusted EPS of US$0.78 missed consensus of about US$0.99, and the shares fell nearly 9%. Coverage blamed credit costs, plus higher AI spending and competition.
facts.note: Consensus figure comes from press coverage. The talk should stay neutral on this.

facts.claim: Shopee GMV was US$39.7 billion, up 23.3% year on year (about 26.5% excluding FX).
facts.note: The FX-neutral figure comes from a transcript summary. Growth slowed from +28.4% in Q2 2026.

facts.claim: Shopee gross orders were 4.5 billion, up 25.5% year on year.
Shopee GAAP revenue was a record of about US$6.1 billion, up about 41% year on year.
facts.note: Sources differ on the growth rate (41.3% vs 41.9%). One search summary gave US$5.3B, which is inconsistent with Q2's US$5.6B; treat US$6.1B as correct.

facts.claim: Shopee adjusted EBITDA was about US$269 million, up about 45% year on year; management called it Shopee's most profitable quarter ever.
Management said it remains on track for FY2026 Shopee GMV growth of about 25% and Shopee adjusted EBITDA of about US$1 billion.
facts.note: Guidance first given earlier and reaffirmed in Q2 and Q3.

facts.claim: Shopee ad revenue grew more than 55% year on year, ad-paying sellers rose 35%, and the ad take rate rose by more than 80 bps. Management credited 'AI-driven ad solutions'.
facts.value: >55% ad revenue growth; +80bps ad take rate
facts.note: From prepared-remarks summaries; exact wording not verified.

facts.claim: Sea quarterly active users (Garena) were 671.7 million.
facts.note: This is a Garena metric; it is not Shopee buyers.

facts.claim: The board approved an additional US$1.0 billion share repurchase authorisation.
Monee GAAP revenue rose 63.9% year on year to US$1.6 billion (from US$989.9 million), driven mainly by credit.
Monee adjusted EBITDA was US$298.3 million, up 15.5% year on year, which is larger than Shopee's US$269M.
Consumer and SME loans principal outstanding reached about US$12.6 billion, up about 60% year on year (about US$11.2B on-book and US$1.3B off-book).
facts.note: On-book and off-book add to 12.5 because of rounding.

facts.claim: The 90+ day NPL ratio was 1.3%, up from 1.0% in Q2 2026 and 1.1% in Q3 2025; coverage tied the rise to Thailand and Brazil credit conditions.
facts.note: Includes on-book and off-book loans (per Q2 definition).

facts.claim: Provisions for credit losses rose about 82% year on year to about US$681.5 million.
Management described Monee as having nearly 44 million active credit users.
facts.note: Single transcript-summary source. Q2 2026 coverage said 40M+. No first-time borrower figure found.

facts.claim: Management said it plans to list Monee as a standalone entity within 1 to 3 years.
facts.note: Forrest Li's October 2026 staff memo (via Bloomberg) said Sea was considering a Monee listing.

facts.claim: In Q2 2026 Shopee GMV was US$38.3B (+28.4%), gross orders were 4.2B (+27.5%), revenue was US$5.6B (+48.2%), and adjusted EBITDA was US$255.4M.
facts.note: Prior quarter, for trend.

facts.claim: In Q2 2026 the Monee loan book was US$11.1B (+62.5% YoY; US$10.0B on-book and US$1.1B off-book), the 90+ day NPL ratio was 1.0%, and adjusted EBITDA was US$288.0M.
facts.note: Management tied the provision growth to off-Shopee SPayLater and higher-risk Brazil lending.

facts.claim: Chris Feng is President of Sea Limited (since January 2022; joined March 2014), and was introduced as President on the 2026 earnings calls.
facts.note: Third-party sites also call him Shopee CEO; Sea's own page does not use that title.

facts.claim: On the Q3 2026 call, Chris Feng reportedly said agentic AI partnerships would not dramatically change Shopee's GMV growth trajectory yet; management frames external agents as an additional channel, with checkout and the seller relationship staying on Shopee.
facts.note: Single secondary paraphrase. Be careful quoting this with Chris Feng in the room.

facts.claim: Sea rebranded SeaMoney to Monee on May 8, 2025, at its 16th anniversary and the opening of its digital financial services HQ in Singapore (Rochester Commons); SeaMoney Credit became Monee Credit effective Sept 11, 2025.
facts.note: The Sept 11, 2025 subsidiary date is from a Shopee PH help page excerpt.

facts.claim: Management said upgraded underwriting models raised approval rates by about 10% versus previous models at a similar risk level. Analysts describe these as Transformer-based models trained on long-sequence ecosystem data.
facts.note: Transformer experimentation was first mentioned on the Q4 2025 call (March 2026).

facts.claim: Management said AI now verifies income documents for credit applications, cutting review time by about 95% with high accuracy.
facts.note: Search-summary paraphrase.

facts.claim: On Feb 19, 2026 Sea and Google signed an MOU expanding their strategic partnership on AI across Shopee, Garena and Monee.
facts.note: This is an MOU; no launch dates were disclosed.

facts.claim: Under the MOU, Shopee and Google will 'jointly explore the building of an AI agentic shopping prototype' that integrates across Shopee and Google platforms.
facts.note: No public launch of the prototype found as of Nov 2026. The MOU builds on the existing YouTube Shopping Affiliate Program with Shopee.

facts.claim: Under the MOU, Monee will collaborate with Google on the open Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), giving 'expert feedback' so it suits Southeast Asia's DFS landscape; the parties may later explore piloting agentic payments.
facts.note: No pilot announced as of Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Garena and Google will use AI to 'transform' game-development productivity; this builds on the Free Fire League on Google Play.

Maybank IB argued that ShopeePay/Monee already controls stored-value balances, KYC-linked identity, merchant acceptance and embedded credit, which could make it a natural execution layer for agentic commerce.
facts.note: Analyst opinion.

facts.claim: Since June 22, 2026 the Shopee app has been available in ChatGPT in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Taiwan, Vietnam and Brazil. ChatGPT surfaces Shopee products and users complete purchases in the Shopee app; eligible SME sellers get trial access to ChatGPT for Business.
facts.note: Discovery only; checkout stays in Shopee. Earlier phases: ChatGPT Plus for Shopee VIP (Aug 2025) and ChatGPT Go (Dec 2025).

facts.claim: Shopee is one of eight launch 'connectors' for Meta's Muse personal AI agent, which launched in Singapore on about Oct 27-28, 2026; it helps users research and compare products before purchasing on Shopee.
facts.note: Whether Muse can complete payment was not disclosed.

facts.claim: By Nov 2026 Shopee is working with several third-party AI agent ecosystems at once: an OpenAI/ChatGPT app (live), Meta Muse (live in SG), and a Google agentic shopping prototype (exploratory MOU).
facts.note: Synthesis of the three facts above.

facts.claim: Shopee seller AI tools include a Chat AI Assistant/AI Shop Chatbot for buyer FAQs (order status, size guidance), a Product AI Optimiser for listings and storefronts, AI LiveStream for 24/7 brand livestreams (expanded at the Feb 11, 2026 Brands Summit), and a Livestream Analysis tool (Q1 2026).
facts.note: Market-level press; no performance metrics verified.

facts.claim: Shopee introduced buyer-facing AI features in the Philippines in early 2026, including a virtual fitting room.
facts.note: No confirmed region-wide in-app conversational shopping assistant launch found.

facts.claim: On the Q3 2025 call, Sea said AI applied to search, recommendation, customer service and ads lifted conversion rates by about 10% year on year.
facts.note: 2025 data from a Chinese-language transcript summary; not re-verified.

facts.claim: In an Oct 2026 staff memo (reported by Bloomberg), Forrest Li announced Sea Cloud, an 'AI-first enterprise platform' to sell cloud services to businesses globally. On the Q3 call he said it will focus on software and orchestration ('put AI to work, running models reliably and securely') rather than owning large physical capacity.
facts.note: Relevant for a Google Cloud presenter: Sea is now a potential cloud competitor or partner. No launch date, pricing or customers disclosed; one source says no enterprise contracts yet.

facts.claim: In Sept 2026 Sea said it will adopt NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform, the first enterprise deployment in Southeast Asia, to build and deploy AI models and agents at greater scale.
facts.note: No financial terms.

facts.claim: Sea set up an AI Centre of Excellence in Singapore with EDB support.
facts.note: Exact date not captured.

facts.claim: Sea's MariBank Philippines (formerly SeaBank Philippines, acquired by MariBank Singapore in April 2025) received a BSP digital bank licence and became the Philippines' 7th digital bank, operating under it from July 18, 2026.
e-Conomy SEA 2026 projects Southeast Asia's digital economy GMV at US$368 billion in 2026 (+17% YoY), passing US$1 trillion by 2035.
facts.note: 11th edition, released Oct 21, 2026. Coverage notes the US$1T goal slipped from 2030 to 2035.

facts.claim: e-Conomy SEA 2026 puts e-commerce GMV at about US$226 billion in 2026 (+18%), and commerce media on e-commerce platforms is a US$4 billion market.
facts.note: Uses a different methodology from Momentum Works platform GMV.

facts.claim: e-Conomy SEA 2026 puts digital payments/DFS gross transaction value at about US$1.65 trillion (+16%) and digital lending balances at about US$116 billion (+22%).
facts.note: Secondary coverage only; check against the PDF.

facts.claim: About 243 million people across SEA-6 use generative AI (58% of the working population), but per-person usage is roughly a tenth of US levels; the report introduces tokens as a measure of AI usage.
facts.note: Secondary coverage.

facts.claim: In a July 2026 Google/YouGov survey of 9,006 AI users for e-Conomy SEA 2026, 75% across SEA-6 said they would let AI find the best price and buy a product (Thailand highest at 85%). Openness depends on transparency, safeguards and reversibility.
facts.note: This is stated intent, not behaviour.

facts.claim: 69% of SEA shoppers use AI to compare complex purchases such as electronics.
Google's Nitin Gajria said Southeast Asia has 'a unique window to lead the world in agentic commerce', subject to clear governance and transparency.
facts.note: Google executive quote.

facts.claim: e-Conomy SEA 2025 projected SEA digital economy GMV to pass US$300 billion in 2025 (+15%), with e-commerce GMV of US$185B and revenue of US$41B.
facts.note: Released Nov 2025.

facts.claim: More than US$2.3B went into over 680 SEA AI startups in H1 2025, over 30% of private funding value.
Momentum Works estimates SEA platform e-commerce GMV at US$157.6B in 2025 (+22.8%), with Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop (incl. Tokopedia) holding 98.8%.
facts.note: Report released April 2026.

facts.claim: Momentum Works estimates Shopee at about 53% share (US$83.2B GMV, up from US$66.8B in 2024) and TikTok Shop at US$45.6B plus Tokopedia at US$9B (about 35% combined, ~66% of Shopee's scale) in 2025.
facts.note: TikTok's share is my calculation: 54.6/157.6. Lazada 2025 GMV was not found; it is implied at about 11% (~US$18B) by subtraction, so it is unverified.

facts.claim: Content (video/live) commerce was US$49.7B, or 32% of SEA platform GMV, in 2025, up from 20% in 2024.

MAS issued final Guidelines on AI Risk Management for financial institutions on Oct 7, 2026, after a Nov 2025 consultation. They cover all AI including generative AI and AI agents, put ultimate accountability on boards and senior management, and are proportionate to risk.
facts.note: Builds on the FEAT principles.

facts.claim: The MAS AI risk guidelines phase in: oversight and risk-management system expectations from Oct 7, 2027, and lifecycle controls and capabilities from Oct 7, 2028.
facts.note: Single tracker source; verify with MAS.

facts.claim: MAS and industry published 'Safeguards for Agentic Finance at Runtime' (SAFR) on July 3, 2026 under BuildFin.ai. It is a voluntary white paper that puts a governance checkpoint between each agent decision and its execution (actions declared, authorised and assessed), with payments within set mandates as a named use case.
facts.note: The most relevant SEA text for agent-initiated payments. A v1.1 (about Oct 9, 2026) reportedly states that an agent 'cannot extend the scope of a mandate through its own reasoning' and adds contributors including Google, DBS and UOB; this is single-source and unverified.

facts.claim: Indonesia's OJK issued AI Governance guidance for Indonesian banks on April 29, 2025. It is principle-based and non-binding but used in supervision, and OJK said in Oct 2026 that it is maintaining this principle-based approach.
facts.note: No OJK AI rule for P2P/non-bank lenders found.

facts.claim: AI adoption in Indonesian banking reached 57.9% in Q1 2026, up from about 30% in 2024 and 42% in 2025 (PERBANAS/IBM data).

The Bank of Thailand issued AI risk management guidelines for financial service providers, including payment providers under the Payment Systems Act, on Sept 12, 2025. They rest on two pillars, governance and development/security controls, and cover third-party AI.
facts.note: Law-firm summary.

facts.claim: BSP issued voluntary 'Governance Principles for AI in Financial Services' (Memorandum M-2026-031, June 24, 2026) under the STARS principles (sustainability, transparency, accountability, responsibility, security). A Feb 2026 draft circular on model risk management also covers AI/ML.
facts.note: Final model-risk circular not confirmed.

facts.claim: Vietnam's Law on Artificial Intelligence took effect on March 1, 2026, with a risk-tier system (high/medium/low); implementing decrees were in draft in early 2026.
facts.note: Law-firm summary.

facts.claim: A State Bank of Vietnam draft circular would require banks and e-wallets to notify customers before using AI tools and give customers a right to complain about AI decisions. An Aug 2026 report says it would cap AI-approved transactions for individuals at VND100 million (~US$3,800), with human sign-off above that, and would class automated transaction execution and autonomous lending decisions as high-risk.
facts.note: Still a draft as of the Aug 2026 report; final issuance not confirmed. Directly relevant to agent-initiated payments.

facts.claim: Google announced the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) on Jan 11, 2026 at NRF, an open standard for agentic checkout in AI Mode in Search and the Gemini app. Checkout started with eligible US merchants (reported live Feb 11, 2026).
facts.note: Ben Byon covers UCP in detail; keep this brief.

facts.claim: In March 2026 UCP added optional Cart (multi-item), Catalog and Identity Linking (loyalty) capabilities (Cart API from spec version 2026-04-08). At Google Marketing Live in May 2026, Google added Universal Cart across retailers, UCP checkout in YouTube Shopping ads, hotel booking (Booking.com, Expedia, Marriott, Hilton) and food delivery (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Square, Toast), and expansion to Canada, Australia, then the UK.
facts.note: No SEA market confirmed live. A Feb 2026 third-party piece said India, Indonesia and LatAm were planned for H2 2026; unverified.

facts.claim: Reports in Oct 2026 say Google is gradually rolling out a Merchant Center UCP integration hub to US merchants, with Canada and Australia facing a 2027 wait.
facts.note: Secondary.

facts.claim: Google donated the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2; announced Sept 2025) to the FIDO Alliance on April 28, 2026 and released AP2 v0.2, which adds 'human-not-present' autonomous purchases under pre-authorised mandates (Intent, Cart and Payment mandates). FIDO formed agentic authentication/payments working groups and also took Mastercard's Verifiable Intent.
facts.note: AP2 launched with 60+ partners; a May 2026 report says 120+, unverified.

facts.claim: At Cloud Next '26 (April 22, 2026), Google renamed Vertex AI the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Vertex AI Agent Engine became 'Agent Runtime', and the platform adds Agent Registry (GA June 18, 2026), Agent Identity (a cryptographic ID per agent) and Agent Gateway (policy enforcement on agent tool calls).
facts.note: Use the new names on slides: 'Vertex AI' and 'Agent Engine' are legacy names as of Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Google Cloud launched Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services on Aug 25, 2026, in preview for capital markets and corporate banking; Deutsche Bank was design partner for a Financial Research agent, and BNY, Citi Wealth, Lloyds, Macquarie and Signal Iduna were named.
facts.note: Secondary; not retail or digital lending focused.

facts.claim: PayPal and Google Cloud launched an agentic commerce solution for merchants in Oct 2025 that uses AP2.
facts.note: A Nexi–Google Cloud MOU pairing UCP and AP2 in Europe was also reported; date unverified.

facts.claim: At The Android Show on May 12, 2026 Google announced 'Gemini Intelligence', an agentic layer that completes multi-step tasks across Android apps with user approval, rolling out from summer 2026 on Galaxy S26 and Pixel 10.
facts.note: Naz Akbari covers Android in detail.

facts.claim: In Feb 2026 Google previewed Gemini 'screen automation' (codename Bonobo, built on Android 16 QPR3), which operates app UIs for select food delivery, grocery and rideshare apps. Users are told to supervise it and not enter login or payment details.

Android AppFunctions (Android 16+, Jetpack library) let apps expose functions to agents like Gemini; Google likens it to MCP on-device. It is an experimental/limited preview in 2026, with a UI-automation fallback for apps without integrations, and Android 17 is meant to broaden both.
facts.note: Status labels conflict across sources (alpha/beta/preview). Expansion to 40+ apps at Galaxy Unpacked on July 22, 2026 is unverified.
